title: •Red Squadron 7
caption: •Red Squadron 7 (V)
game_text: Heroic. May add 1 pilot. Once per game may place a non-{alter} Effect at same system in owner’s Used Pile. Corran Horn and Keir Santage deploy -1 aboard; if either piloting, immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Incom starfighter flown by Keir Santage. Flew twelve sorties against Imperial shipyards at Fondor.
